objective: A frozen census on the 5 x 5 tube at g = 3: the tree of schedules of up to three runs with every stage balanced, with each original ring's first hearing lag of ring (0, 0); outcomes O1 (distance 1 heard before distance 2, every stage balanced to 40 x 40), O2 (distance 2 first heard after a later doubling than distance 1) and O3 (the hearing lags form a metric that reads the lattice distance); positives confirmed on the full state at 40 x 40 and at 80 x 80 by the territory reader and a second independent code.
title: A growing plane that reads distance 1 then 2
